title: Chemical peels in Cairo
description: Plan a chemical peel consultation in Cairo for uneven tone or texture. Understand peel depth, preparation, pigment risks and skin care during healing.
answer: A chemical peel applies a solution to remove surface layers of skin in a controlled way. Adults with uneven tone, rough texture or some acne marks can ask about peels at {{brand}} in New Cairo and Mohandessin. Skin sensitivity, pigment history and recent medicines influence the choice of peel and recovery plan.
preparation: We assess your skin, review your current products and check whether a peel is suitable now.
howPerformed: A chemical peel applies a solution to the skin to remove surface layers in a controlled way. Different ingredients and depths are used for concerns such as uneven tone, acne marks or rough texture.
followup: A superficial peel may cause mild redness or light flaking. A deeper peel can involve several days of visible peeling and needs more recovery time. Follow the aftercare plan, use the advised sun protection and avoid picking at peeling skin.
suitability: Peels may be considered for uneven tone, some acne marks and rough texture. Active infection, irritation and certain medicines can affect timing or suitability, so a skin assessment comes first.
outlook: Skin may look more even and feel smoother once it has healed. The timing depends on peel depth, and some concerns need more than one session. We will review the result before recommending another peel.

faqs.a: It depends on the peel and your skin. Even a superficial peel may cause some flaking, while deeper peels usually involve more visible shedding. We will explain what is likely with your treatment.
Tingling, warmth or stinging can occur. We monitor your skin during the procedure. Tell us immediately if the sensation becomes painful so we can respond.

faqs.q: Can peels be done in summer?
faqs.a: Some superficial peels may be possible if you can follow sun protection and aftercare advice. Strong sun exposure can affect timing, especially for deeper peels. We will help you choose a suitable date.
